dateline: BTS opened the São Paulo leg of the ARIRANG World Tour at Estádio MorumBIS on Oct 28; the Oct 30 and 31 shows took place but only single-outlet coverage exists so far. Next: Kaohsiung, Nov 19–22.
heroHeadline: Day 4,890: BTS Open São Paulo Run With Portuguese Shout-Outs
heroSubtitle: November 2, 2026 is Day 4,890 since BTS’s June 13, 2013 debut. The Oct 28 São Paulo opener ran 23 songs in about 2h20; the Oct 30 and 31 shows are not yet verified.
